from qiskit_algorithms.initial_points import NumPyMinimumEigensolverInitialPoint
from qiskit_nature.transformers.second_quantization.electronic import FreezeCoreTransformer

def vqe_n2_sto3g_cas66():
    # Define the nitrogen molecule
    molecule = Molecule(
        geometry=[['N', [0., 0., 0.]], ['N', [0., 0., 1.098]]],
        charge=0,
        multiplicity=1,
        units=UnitsType.ANGSTROM
    )

    # Set up the driver
    driver = ElectronicStructureDriver(
        molecule=molecule,
        basis='sto3g',
        driver_type=ElectronicStructureDriverType.PYSCF
    )

    # Add transformers
    freeze_core_transformer = FreezeCoreTransformer(freeze_core=True, remove_orbitals=[3])
    active_space_transformer = ActiveSpaceTransformer(num_electrons=6, num_molecular_orbitals=6)

    electronic_structure_problem = active_space_transformer.transform(electronic_structure_problem)
    electronic_structure_problem = freeze_core_transformer.transform(electronic_structure_problem)

    # Map the problem to qubits

    # Reference energy using exact solver
    reference_solver = NumPyMinimumEigensolver()
    reference_result = reference_solver.compute_minimum_eigenvalue(qubit_ops)
    reference_energy = reference_result.eigenvalue.real

    # Set up VQE
    optimizer = SPSA(maxiter=100)
    ansatz = TwoLocal(rotation_blocks='ry', entanglement_blocks='cz', reps=3, entanglement='linear')
    initial_point = NumPyMinimumEigensolverInitialPoint()
    initial_point.assign_operators(qubit_ops, None)
    vqe = VQE(ansatz=ansatz, optimizer=optimizer, initial_point=initial_point)

    # Run VQE
    vqe_result = vqe.compute_minimum_eigenvalue(qubit_ops)
    ground_state_energy_estimate = vqe_result.eigenvalue.real

    # Calculate energy error
    energy_error_against_reference = abs(ground_state_energy_estimate - reference_energy)

    # Check chemical accuracy
    chemical_accuracy_achievement = energy_error_against_reference < 1e-6

    # Measure the cost
    measurement_cost = vqe_result.optimizer_result.nfev
    qubit_count = len(qubit_ops.primitive.paulis[0].z)
    circuit_depth = vqe_result.cost_function_evals
    gate_count = ansatz.decompose().count_ops()['gate']

    return {
        "ground_state_energy_estimate": ground_state_energy_estimate,
        "energy_error_against_reference": energy_error_against_reference,
        "chemical_accuracy_achievement": chemical_accuracy_achievement,
        "measurement_cost": measurement_cost,
        "qubit_count": qubit_count,
        "circuit_depth": circuit_depth,
        "gate_count": gate_count
    }
